ntations of tuberculosis and atypical pneumonia (18). panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Coronal non-contrast CT shows right frontoparietal epidural collection in article titled Intracranial Manifestation of Melioidosis. Captioned manifestation attributed to melioidosis via disease-focused title plus specific manifestation. Mapped to bone and soft-tissue abscess component of osteomyelitis vocabulary key; epidural abscess term proposed as not in vocabulary. B: Sagittal non-contrast CT shows same right frontoparietal epidural collection. Same disease attribution as panel A. Vocabulary mapping to abscess associated with osteomyelitis; specific intracranial epidural location proposed. C: Bone-window CT shows scalloping of inner table with suspected osteomyelitis in intracranial melioidosis case. Direct caption phrase supports osteomyelitis vocabulary key as cortical erosion / bone infection manifestation. D: Axial non-contrast CT shows same right frontoparietal epidural collection. Same disease attribution and vocabulary...

in_text_mentions: sed sensitivity to light, decreased ability to concentrate, and irritability. He sought medical advice at the primary health care centre and was referred to get a computerized tomography (CT) of the brain. This showed a large epidural mass at the right frontoparietal area that crossed the midline and compressed the sagittal sinus (Figure 1A, B and D). The adjacent neurocranium showed scalloping of the inner table (Figure 1C). Initial radiological diagnosis was an organised chronic epidural hematoma and accordingly, he was referred to the emergency department at Sahlgrenska University Hospital.
